import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd();plan=dict(url='https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0209399',routes=['377606','382541'],destination='sources/hillar-johnson.pdf',source_identity='Hillar Johnson symmetric word equations original2002',purpose='Pay definitions and public solution context for both matrix word targets')
p=lane/'get-words.json';r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),p.name],input=json.dumps(plan),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'source_get_guard.py'),str(p)],text=True,capture_output=True);print(r.stdout,r.stderr);assert r.returncode==0
